title: PACE%2BCode%2BD%2B2023.pdf — section 103
text:
27. The suspect may take whatever position in the group they wish. If there is more than one
witness, the suspect must be told, out of the sight and hearing of any witness, that they can,
if they wish, change their position in the group.

28. The witness shall be asked to pass along, or amongst, the group and to look at each person
in the group at least twice, taking as much care and time as possible according to the
circumstances, before making an identification. Once the witness has done this, they shall
be asked whether the person they saw on the specified earlier occasion is in the group and
to indicate any such person by whatever means the person conducting the procedure
considers appropriate in the circumstances. If this is not practicable, the witness shall be
asked to point out any person they think they saw on the earlier occasion.
